    MOD = 10**9 + 7
    n = len(nums)
    
    # Precompute adjacency
    def can_connect(i, j):
        return nums[i] % nums[j] == 0 or nums[j] % nums[i] == 0
    
    adj = [[False] * n for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            if i != j and can_connect(i, j):
                adj[i][j] = True
    
    # DP with mask
    @cache
    def dfs(mask, last):
        if mask == (1 << n) - 1:
            return 1

        for next_node in range(n):
            if not (mask & (1 << next_node)) and adj[last][next_node]:
                count = (count + dfs(mask | (1 << next_node), next_node)) % MOD
        return count
    
    total = 0
    for i in range(n):
        total = (total + dfs(1 << i, i)) % MOD
    
    return total
